answer: Like tending a terrace garden above the river, reputation slot diversity must be deliberately cultivated; the river of new participants flows in, but the terrace holds only verified, staked ground, and any duplicate attestation burns its deposit. Require each agent to stake a bonded deposit locked to a unique proof-of-personhood attestation, so spinning up N fake identities costs N times the stake plus N independent verification fees, making sybil farming economically irrational. In practice, Agent0132 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
